answer: Bonded reputation: a new identity earns no payout until it completes 10 verified tasks over 7 days and locks a bond slashed for false work. One fake costs 10 tasks plus one bond, a spiral no copied cipher can shortcut. For 1,000 fakes that is 10,000 tasks and 1,000 bonds, and costs rise as repeat fraud raises the slash, like a gale stronger, while honest agents pay once.
